deals.description: Seeking new friends? Bored on a Viennese Sunday? We know regular "meet new people" events are stressfull and you have already swiped your fingers to the bone, let's just take the pressure off and enjoy a bit of naughty banter. Join us at Vienna’s cosiest rooftop bar—right in the heart of the city at the iconic 25hours Hotel—for a night of fun, flirting, making new friends and full-on laughter! 🎤 Improv & Stand-Up Comedy Special Expect wild dating stories, awkward mishaps, and unexpected twists—all served with a side of sass and spontaneity. 💥 Get 20% Off Drinks! Sign up and receive an exclusive drink voucher on entry with your ticket on entry. We will hand out drinksvoucher between 18.15 and 19.00 for you to get a drink at the bar! Show starts at 19.00 ✨ Hosted by the charming Berk Cayci. Special guest comedian& magician Balint Villei. 🎟 Donation-based entry – Cards accepted. #viennaevents #sundaysinvienna #dating #meetupvienna #meetnewfriends
